## TemplateManager.registerCompiled() method

Registers a pre-compiled template directly into the render map.

**Signature:**

```typescript
registerCompiled(key: string, compiled: ICompiledTemplate): void;
```

## Remarks

AOT path: the caller (build-time emitter output) already validated the source, so this skips `_validateTemplate` by design. Mirrors `_compile` by not firing `_onReload` — reload fires once per batch load, not per entry.
